message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on incoming data; `assert_for_log` is used only for configuration/logic guards, not data validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: ELMo weights and options are fetched from a hardcoded S3 URL with no checksum verification, signature validation, or pinned revision.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preprocessing pipeline performs tokenization and indexing but includes no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained weights and model states (via load_model_state, ELMo weights from S3 URLs, and HuggingFace transformers) without any hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision controls.
No detected label distribution validation: No code performs class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the visible code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metric cross-checks in the visible code.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation, schema checks, or shape/range guards are visible in the inference data-flow path; inputs are consumed directly from CLI args and raw data loaders.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validations on model outputs are present in the visible code slices.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses task-based NLP models (classification, tagging, etc.), not a generative LLM, and there are no input-filtering or content-moderation controls present.
